AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. C — Glucose and oxygen

3. A — Ice melting to water

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.

6. C — 100 °C

7. A — newton (N)

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

10. D — Producers

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Management of Agro- byproducts; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
